readinessDecision: Six is the highest actual flow concurrency seen, only briefly in both intervals. Twelve was a configured ceiling and was not reached or validated. Active bursts exceeded current method/usefulness capacity and unsupported protocol variants invalidated affected scopes; quiet audited rejections and successful individual normalizations do not prove complete active windows or held protection.
